title: SVA Liveness Property Missing — Deadlock Undetected
description: The testbench has only safety assertions (no illegal states), but lacks a liveness assertion that ARREADY must eventually be asserted after ARVALID, allowing a deadlock to go undetected.
bug_signature: UVM_INFO: All safety assertions passed. Simulation completed. (ARREADY never asserted — missed by lack of liveness check)
expected_root_cause: Verification gap: no `eventually` or bounded-liveness SVA to ensure ARREADY responds within N cycles of ARVALID [21, 22].
failure_log:
ARVALID=1 for 10000 cycles. ARREADY never seen. Test PASSED (no liveness check).
UVM_ERROR (after adding assertion): Liveness violation.
success_log: Assertion fires within 16 cycles of ARVALID asserting.
fix_replacement: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (!rst_n) arvalid |-> ##[1:16] arready);
testbench: initial assert property (@(posedge clk) arvalid |-> ##[1:16] arready);
